visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The host, a male with dark hair wearing a black outfit, stands in a brightly lit luxury cosmetic store. He holds a black folding fan and a RODE microphone, smiling broadly at the camera. Behind him is a large GUERLAIN sign and shelves filled with neatly arranged perfume bottles and cosmetics. The lighting is bright and professional, characteristic of a high-end retail environment. (2) The scene cuts to a younger male staff member in a black uniform who waves to the camera. The host joins him, and they engage in a lively conversation. They are surrounded by tiered displays of glass perfume bottles with gold caps. Large digital screens in the background display vibrant floral and product imagery, contributing to a high-saturation, premium visual style. (3) The video focuses on product close-ups. A hand holds a bottle of Rose Centifolia perfume with red liquid. Later, a hand applies a cream from a gold tube onto skin, demonstrating its texture. Digital overlays of actress Song Hye-kyo appear on the background screens. The camera uses medium shots and close-ups to highlight product details and facial expressions. (4) In the final segment, the host showcases a scalp serum bottle. A woman with long dark hair is seen from the back as the serum is applied to her scalp and massaged. The host returns to the center of the frame, gesturing enthusiastically as he wraps up the presentation in front of the Guerlain counter, maintaining a fast-paced, rhythmic editing style.
